proposals.before: All other decapitation and strangulation cases were likewise submitted by special memorial; summary slips went to the judicial censors, the Grand Secretariat drafted rescripts, and the Three Judicial Offices conducted joint review.
proposals.after: All other decapitation and strangulation cases were likewise submitted by special memorial; summary slips went to the judicial offices, the offices of scrutiny, and the censors; the Grand Secretariat drafted rescripts, and the Three Judicial Offices conducted joint review.
proposals.reason: 法司科道 names the judicial offices together with the offices of scrutiny (科) and censors (道), not a single class of judicial censors.

proposals.before: In his thirty-second year the emperor promulgated forty comparative guidelines, distributed them to each bureau and to every province, and made them the standard for classification.
proposals.after: In the thirty-second year, forty comparative guidelines were first drawn up, printed and distributed to each bureau, and also promulgated to all provinces as the standard for classification.
proposals.reason: Chinese 始酌定 is impersonal and does not name the emperor as the agent; the idiomatic rendering invents an imperial promulgation and a possessive 'his'.

proposals.before: Those classified as meriting compassion might have exile or penal servitude reduced.
proposals.after: Those classified as meriting compassion were either reduced to exile or reduced to penal servitude.
proposals.reason: 減流 and 減徒 mean commutation of the death sentence down to exile or penal servitude, not a reduction of those punishments themselves.

proposals.before: In the thirty-first year of Qianlong, the Hunan official offender Rao Qian was granted execution for shielding his own fault.
proposals.after: In the thirty-first year of Qianlong, the Hunan official offender Rao Qian was marked for execution for shielding his own fault.
proposals.reason: 予句 is the autumn-review tick marking a prisoner for execution, not a grant of execution as a favor.

proposals.before: He urgently ordered the Hunan governor to suspend Rao Qian's execution, told the ministry to establish that the two cases differed in circumstance, and only then issued clear instructions on punishment.
proposals.after: He urgently ordered the Hunan governor to suspend Rao Qian's execution, ordered the Ministry of Justice to ascertain the circumstances of the two cases, and only after they were found to differ issued clear instructions on punishment.
proposals.reason: 令刑部查明兩案情節不同 is an investigation whose difference is the condition for the later instruction, not an order to establish a predetermined difference.

proposals.before: If the destination was near, or if prisoners were bound for southeastern provinces and circumstances favored proceeding, they were dispatched as usual.
proposals.after: If the destination was near, or if prisoners were bound for southeastern provinces and were willing to proceed, they were dispatched as usual.
proposals.reason: 情原前進 is 情愿前進: the prisoner's willingness to go on, not generic favorable circumstances.

proposals.before: Appeals went to prefecture, circuit, provincial judge, or governor's office; skipping levels brought beating with the rod.
proposals.after: If unsatisfied with the verdict, they appealed to prefecture, circuit, provincial judge, or governor's office; skipping levels brought beating with the rod.
proposals.reason: 不服 means the party does not accept the first-instance verdict and therefore appeals, not a generic statement that appeals simply went up the ladder.

proposals.before: The Code's Eight Privileges required a sealed memorial before interrogation; unauthorized execution was forbidden.
proposals.after: The Code's Eight Privileges required a sealed memorial requesting instruction before interrogation; unauthorized interrogation was forbidden.
proposals.reason: 不許擅自句問 forbids unauthorized interrogation (勾問), not execution; 請旨 is a request for imperial instruction.

proposals.before: Aisin Gioro were tried with the ministry joining the Imperial Clan Court.
proposals.after: Gioro were tried with the ministry joining the Imperial Clan Court.
proposals.reason: 覺羅 here is the Gioro collateral imperial kin, distinct from 宗室 and from the imperial Aisin Gioro surname.

proposals.before: For the six-month limit, prefecture and county had three months to send up to prefecture, prefecture one month to provincial judge, judge one month to governor, governor one month to memorialize.
proposals.after: For the six-month limit, departments and counties had three months to send up to the prefecture; the prefecture one month to the provincial judge; the judge one month to the governor-general or governor; the governor one month to consult and memorialize.
proposals.reason: 州縣三月解府州 is counties/departments forwarding to the prefecture, not prefecture-and-county sending up to a prefecture a second time.

proposals.before: For the four-month limit, prefecture and county had two months to prefecture, prefecture twenty days to judge, judge twenty days to governor, governor twenty days to memorialize.
proposals.after: For the four-month limit, departments and counties had two months to send up to the prefecture; the prefecture twenty days to the provincial judge; the judge twenty days to the governor-general or governor; the governor twenty days to consult and memorialize.
proposals.reason: Same staging as the six-month rule: 州縣解府州 is the first upward transfer, not a loop from prefecture to prefecture.

proposals.before: Capital penal-servitude offenders were assigned to Shuntian prefecture.
proposals.after: For current review in the capital, penal-servitude offenders were assigned to Shuntian Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 京師現審 is capital-city current review, not capital (death) sentences; 徒犯 are penal-servitude offenders in that Beijing procedure.

proposals.before: This was recorded in the treaties and kept as proof on the left.
proposals.after: This was recorded in the treaties and kept as a formal pledge.
proposals.reason: 左券 is the creditor's half of a split tally used as proof of a contract, not a spatial 'left' location; the current literal obscures that legal-metaphor meaning.

proposals.before: Not until Jiaqing 25 were prisoners who had reached their place of assignment but served less than three years included in general review—a precedent widely regarded as excessive.
proposals.after: Not until Jiaqing 25 were prisoners who had reached their place of assignment but served less than three years included in general review—an especially rare act of grace.
proposals.reason: 曠典 means a rare or extraordinary gracious statute, not an excessive or overreaching precedent.

proposals.before: By the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, those who had reached assignment but not yet three years were all investigated and handled together—especially an empty precedent.
proposals.after: By the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, those who had reached assignment but not yet three years were all investigated and handled together—especially a rare gracious statute.
proposals.reason: 曠 here is not 'empty'; 曠典 is the conventional term for an exceptionally generous imperial grace.

decisions.reason: 分送揭帖於法司科道 names three recipients—the judicial offices (法司), the offices of scrutiny (科), and the censors (道)—not a single class of judicial censors; the replacement restores that distinction before 內閣票擬 and 三法司核議.
三十二年，始酌定 is impersonal: the forty comparative clauses were first weighed and fixed, then printed and issued; the original invents an emperor as promulgator and a possessive 'his'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 三十二年，始酌定比對條款四十則，刊分各司，並頒諸各省

decisions.reason: 入可矜者，或減流，或減徒 commutes a death-category prisoner down to exile or penal servitude; the original wrongly treats 流 and 徒 as punishments already imposed and then reduced.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 入可矜者，或減流，或減徒

decisions.reason: 予句 is the autumn-review tick that marks a prisoner for execution, not a grant of execution as a favor; the proposed literal matches the chapter's own idiomatic 'marked for execution'.
令刑部查明兩案情節不同，始行明諭處分 orders an inquiry whose finding of difference is the condition for later instructions, not an order to establish a predetermined difference.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 令刑部查明兩案情節不同，始行明諭處分

decisions.reason: 人犯有情原前進者 is 情愿前進: prisoners willing to go on, not generic favorable circumstances; the replacement restores the agent's will.
不服，控府、控道、控司、控院 states that appeal follows refusal to accept the first-instance verdict; the original omitted 不服.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 不服，控府、控道、控司、控院

decisions.reason: 實封奏聞請旨，不許擅自句問 requires a sealed request for instruction and forbids unauthorized interrogation (勾問), not unauthorized execution.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 實封奏聞請旨，不許擅自句問

decisions.reason: 覺羅 names the Gioro collateral kin, set apart from 宗室 in the preceding sentence and tried with the ministry joining the Imperial Clan Court; 'Aisin Gioro' collapses that legal distinction.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 覺羅，刑部會宗人府審理

decisions.reason: 州縣三月解府州 is the first upward transfer from departments and counties to the prefectural level, then 府州一月解司; the original loops prefecture-and-county back to prefecture and also drops 咨 in 咨題 and the 督撫 pair.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 州縣三月解府州，府州一月解司，司一月解督撫，督撫一月咨題

decisions.reason: 州縣兩月解府州 repeats the same staging as the six-month rule: departments and counties forward to the prefecture, not a prefecture-to-prefecture loop; 督撫 and 咨題 are likewise restored.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 州縣兩月解府州，府州二十日解司，司二十日解督撫，督撫二十日咨題

decisions.reason: 京師現審 is current review of cases in the capital, not a capital (death) sentence; 徒犯發順天府充徒 assigns penal-servitude offenders in that Beijing procedure to Shuntian Prefecture.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 京師現審，徒犯發順天府充徒

decisions.reason: 存為左券 uses the split-tally metaphor for a retained contractual pledge, not a spatial 'left' location; 'formal pledge' matches the established idiomatic rendering.
尤為曠典 is an especially rare gracious statute, not a precedent regarded as excessive; the replacement restores the conventional sense of imperial grace.
曠典 is not an 'empty' precedent; the literal must render it as an exceptionally generous gracious statute, matching the same phrase repaired in the idiomatic field.
